cases.name: unknown-tdc-child
cases.description: A tag inside <tdc> that is neither env nor block

cases.name: self-closing-env
cases.description: A self-closing <env> would discard count and seed

cases.name: bad-count
cases.description: A count that is not a whole number

cases.name: inject-without-slot
cases.description: An inject with no % — interpolation would never match

cases.name: valid-does-not-live-in-env
cases.description: <valid> is a pack generator's reject rule, not an <env> construct — four implementations accepted it here and silently ignored the predicate, which is worse than refusing

cases.name: inject-with-nothing-after-the-placeholder
cases.description: The renderer splits the pattern on `(.+)%(.+)`, so a "%" needs something on BOTH sides. Counting the "%" alone let "%%" through: it has one, it cannot be split, and the renderer quietly stopped interpolating — every reference reached the output verbatim.

cases.name: inject-with-nothing-before-the-placeholder
cases.description: Same hole from the other end: "%x" has a "%" and no opening part.

cases.name: inject-wrapping-its-own-per-cent-sign-is-accepted
cases.description: The line the check must not cross: `%{%}%` is documented and works — the usable "%" is the middle one, not the first. A check that looked at the first "%" would refuse it.
